#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Simple test to demonstrate the separability matrix bug and fix
"""

import numpy as np

def simulate_separability_issue():
    """Simulate the bug in _cstack function"""
    
    # Simulate the separability matrix that would be computed for cm = Linear1D & Linear1D  
    # This should be a 2x2 diagonal matrix
    cm_matrix = np.array([[True, False], 
                         [False, True]])
    print("cm separability matrix (Linear1D & Linear1D):")
    print(cm_matrix)
    print()
    
    # Simulate Pix2Sky_TAN separability matrix (2x2, all True - not separable)
    pix2sky_matrix = np.array([[True, True],
                              [True, True]])
    print("Pix2Sky_TAN separability matrix:")
    print(pix2sky_matrix)
    print()
    
    # Now simulate what happens in _cstack when combining Pix2Sky_TAN & cm
    # The total outputs = 2 + 2 = 4
    # The total inputs = 2 + 2 = 4
    noutp = 4
    total_inputs = 4
    
    # Left side (Pix2Sky_TAN)
    cleft = np.zeros((noutp, pix2sky_matrix.shape[1]))
    cleft[:pix2sky_matrix.shape[0], :pix2sky_matrix.shape[1]] = pix2sky_matrix
    print("cleft matrix (Pix2Sky_TAN positioned):")
    print(cleft)
    print()
    
    # Right side - BUGGY VERSION (line 245 in original code)
    cright_buggy = np.zeros((noutp, cm_matrix.shape[1]))
    cright_buggy[-cm_matrix.shape[0]:, -cm_matrix.shape[1]:] = 1  # BUG: sets all to 1
    print("cright_buggy matrix (sets all to 1 - THIS IS THE BUG):")
    print(cright_buggy)
    print()
    
    # Right side - FIXED VERSION 
    cright_fixed = np.zeros((noutp, cm_matrix.shape[1]))
    cright_fixed[-cm_matrix.shape[0]:, -cm_matrix.shape[1]:] = cm_matrix  # FIX: preserves matrix
    print("cright_fixed matrix (preserves separability info):")
    print(cright_fixed)
    print()
    
    # Final result with bug
    result_buggy = np.hstack([cleft, cright_buggy])
    print("Final result with bug:")
    print(result_buggy)
    print()
    
    # Final result with fix  
    result_fixed = np.hstack([cleft, cright_fixed])
    print("Final result with fix:")
    print(result_fixed)
    print()
    
    # Expected result (what we get when not nesting)
    expected = np.array([[True, True, False, False],
                        [True, True, False, False], 
                        [False, False, True, False],
                        [False, False, False, True]])
    print("Expected result (Pix2Sky_TAN & Linear1D & Linear1D):")
    print(expected)
    print()
    
    print("Fixed result matches expected:", np.array_equal(result_fixed, expected))
    print("Buggy result matches expected:", np.array_equal(result_buggy, expected))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    simulate_separability_issue()
